rows.text: Fault identified, undergoing emergency repairs...
rows.speaker: Busy Little Robot

rows.text: Verification error, verification error. So... what is the cause of this?
rows.speaker: Perplexed Little Robot

rows.text: These robots helping out make everything so easy.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Hopeful Creation

rows.text: Next, once repairs are all done, we can get something ready for Ms. Ruan Mei. Um, what should I prepare?
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Hopeful Creation

rows.text: Whatever it is, I'm sure it's gonna be a huge surprise!
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Enthusiastic Creation

rows.text: She's gonna love it.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Hopeful Creation

rows.text: I heard that those robots... have never been shut down since the day they'd been activated. They just keep going.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Astonished Creation

rows.text: Who did you hear that from?
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Indifferent Creation

rows.text: It was "Super Annoy" who let it slip. And I've been watching and found out that they work all day long...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Astonished Creation

rows.text: Lies, that has to be lies. Impossible. Robots still need to recharge their batteries.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Indifferent Creation

rows.text: Feels like... I'll never... love again.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Sad Creation

rows.text: Yeah, same...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Sullen Creation

rows.text: It's her. She's the one who left us... and took our hearts with her.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Sad Creation

rows.text: I'm not shedding another tear for her, because my tears... have run dry.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Sullen Creation

rows.text: Huh? Are you Pineapple Bun? I can smell you from here...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Passerby Creation

rows.text: I have to say, pineapple-scented tears sure smell sweet. I love it!
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Passerby Creation

rows.text: I heard that he figured out how to go far away...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Staunch Creation

rows.text: Not just that, he's the only one of us that can actually talk.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Bewildered Creation

rows.text: Are you looking for him too? I heard he left not long ago.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Staunch Creation

rows.text: We should've bounced from this place ages ago. Staying here is just a waste of life!
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Staunch Creation

rows.text: I just heard the "Insighter" giving a lecture. It was incredible!
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Excited Creation

rows.text: This guy talks so much. Just looking at him gives me a headache.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Disdainful Creation

rows.text: Don't say that. It's been to so many places on the space station and has broad knowledge. Plus... Ms. Ruan Mei favors it.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Excited Creation

rows.text: Bah, I don't believe it. You don't know, do you? This guy's name is "Molten Cheese Tart," is incredibly uncultured, but likes to pretend that it's seen the world. Hmph...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Disdainful Creation

rows.text: ...Why would you throw me in here after creating me...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Lonely Creation

rows.text: No no no, it's not her fault. It's me... it's all my fault.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Lonely Creation

rows.text: Love and care, these things aren't meant for me.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Lonely Creation

rows.text: I'm a waste of space... No, I'm not even that. I am a void of nothingness...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Lonely Creation

rows.text: It's scary outside. If it were not for our Sir Exemplary, then we'd surely... *sob*
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Timid Creation

rows.text: I want a name just like Wendy... It sounds so cool.
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Curious Creation

rows.text: I heard that Wubbie saying that every one of the researchers shares the same surname. So have you decided what Wen to call yourself?
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Gentle Creation

rows.text: Do you mean... the model that Joseph... "summoned"?
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Curious Creation

rows.text: Yes. I heard it lives above our heads...
rows.speaker: Ruan Mei's Gentle Creation
